question: Marco is 45, cycles to work and reads a lot about climate. Which is more likely?
options: He owns a car and has solar panels
answer: Every person with a car and panels also has a car, so the second group sits entirely inside the first and cannot be larger. Adding a detail that fits the story makes a claim feel likelier while making it strictly less likely.
move: Adding detail makes a claim more convincing and less probable at the same time.
trap: The second one fits the picture better, so it feels more probable.
simply: Every dog wearing a hat is a dog. So there can never be more dogs-in-hats than there are dogs. However well the hat fits the story.
